title: Hearty Herbal Greek Couscous Baklava
description: A savory and pillowy Greek dish featuring couscous, clay-pot-cooked to perfection and formed into a show-off baklava, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large clay pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the dried thyme and oregano.
Add the couscous to the pot, stirring to combine with the onion and garlic mixture.
Cook the couscous according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, combine the crumbly feta cheese and pitted kalamata olives.

To assemble the baklava, create a layer of couscous in a slate-tile vessel, followed by a layer of the feta and olive mixture, repeating this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of couscous on top.
